accepted_user_requirement: 72 mm clear finger width; this overrides the earlier92 mm design/scan-derived target.
scope: Independent dimensional feasibility for a flat32 mm-height device with existing purchased spring/rod/seat/lock hardware; no full model, Onshape change or qualification.

simple_bounds.local_relief: A localR12 moving-seat relief behindthe protected pocket can accommodate the22mm seats while preserving the72mm opening; actual ligament/assembly checks remain required.
simple_bounds.zero_wall_mathematical_bound: 72+2*(8+1+12+3)=120 mm using onlyOD16 lock clearance, zero pocket sidewall; not a practical design.
simple_bounds.100mm_same_stack: 100 mm with24mm supports+3mm borders leaves axes atY±35; OD16 locks would extend inward toY±27, inside a72mm openingY±36. Thus100 mm cannot keep this same axial/height stack without moving components away fromthe grip zone.

front_mount_corridor.unchanged_mount_lower_bound: 26+21+2+12=61 mm spring axis; frame2*(61+12+3)=152 mm evenif the finger opening is only72 mm.
front_mount_corridor.132_ear_shift_problem: Moving the existing21mm ears inward13 mm givesY16..37. They overlap the fixed sensor wallY0..24; M4heads and bores also intrude into it. This is a real redesign requirement, not a safe parameter shift.
front_mount_corridor.138_ear_shift_problem: Only14mm remains between the sensor wall and front rod support, still7mm less than the existing21mm ear.
front_mount_corridor.possible_new_mount: A singleM4 per side can geometricallyfit an11mm wing atY26..37 withcenter±31.5 and1.5mm nominal head edge margin. This halves bolt count and is not an equivalent joint; a different bracket/anchor/load-spreading design must be qualified.
front_mount_corridor.longitudinal_hole_pair: TwoM4counterbores do notfit within the current13mm-X by11mm-Y wing while retaining edge margins. Moving anchors alongX interacts with the existing enclosure onthe wrist side and P05yoke onthe front side.
front_mount_corridor.front_block_stagger: Simply moving fixed rod blocks forward runs into the floating yoke or compression springs; moving them rearward enters the palm/core/enclosure and changes146mm rod engagement. Longitudinal staggering is a new architecture, not automatically feasible.

click_and_stop_constraints.coil_envelope_conflict: At the narrower axes, the present switchbody overlaps the lower inner sector ofthe spring envelope over multiple coil pitches.
click_and_stop_constraints.naive_inward_click_shift: Moving the switch and cam inward7..10mm clears the spring but moves the cam head nearY−27.5..−24.5 into the negativeM4 stop blockY−29..−19 at roughly29..30mm stroke.
click_and_stop_constraints.coordinated_option: Shift the entire switch/pedestal/lever/roller/cam feature andH10 about+37mmY, putting camY+2.5 and bodyY−17..2.8. This can clear both side springs and stop rows in principle. The existing female guide cut must also be applied to the relocated cam underside.
click_and_stop_constraints.further_conflicts: The central switch position conflicts with the existing front bench mounting/countersinks and insert locations. Relocate optional bench mounts and verify installation/tool access, all0..30mm travel, preload0..2, and NCactivation lead beforethe hard stop.
click_and_stop_constraints.electrical_effect: Same NCswitch/contact and firmware interface can be retained nominally; physical trip position and wire routing need requalification.

palm_and_electronics_envelopes.caveat: Their global width fits, but global bounding-boxfit doesnot resolve the front ear/rod/sensor-wall interference or mounting strength.

candidate_recommendation.132mm: Credible flat packaging target to model only after designing a new palm attachment and coordinated central click/bench arrangement. Retain current spring/seats/rods/locks and protected72mm grip; no full-model or strength pass claimed.
candidate_recommendation.138mm: Simpler unrelieved spring-seat packaging, but still requires a new palm attachment and click layout; original mount cannot be preserved.
candidate_recommendation.152mm: Available if keeping original-width palm ears and nominal2mm front clearances is moreimportant than further width reduction.
candidate_recommendation.100mm: Not established flat with the same compact spring stack; requires major longitudinal rearrangement, a new transmission, different hardware or different operating modes.

limitations: Nominal scalarforce law1:1 and spring lengths can remain unchanged at132/138, but friction, off-axis response, stiffness, fatigue and accuracy are not established.
The72mm opening is treated as the user-specified requirement; the previous92mm assumption is not reimposed. Physical fit still needs a prototype.
No current CAD, prior study, production package, firmware or Onshape state is edited.
